_meta.description: Beyond Paradise Adventures source tier registry. Every claim in facts.json must reference a source from this registry. Tier 1 = highest trust. Tier 6 = firsthand (Tim/Kim).

1.label: Official / Scientific authority
1.description: Government bodies, IUCN, peer-reviewed journals, official park authorities. Highest trust — cite directly.
examples: Marine Parks and Reserves Unit Tanzania
peer-reviewed journals (PLOS ONE, Marine Mammal Science, Oryx)

2.label: Established research institutions
2.description: NGOs with peer-reviewed research output, citizen-science databases with methodology, conservation programme reports.

3.label: Reputable reference organisations
3.description: Industry bodies, national tourism authorities, established conservation trusts. Use with secondary corroboration.

4.label: Established travel / industry sources
4.description: Reputable travel publishers, established tour operators with documented methodology. Use only for logistics (prices, transfers, distances) not wildlife claims.

5.label: Operator communications
5.description: Individual lodge or operator data. Treat as single source only — must have Tier 1–3 corroboration for any factual claim.

6.label: Tim / Kim firsthand
6.description: Tim Hennig or Kim direct observation during a paid visit. Highest value for subjective experience, lodge character, encounter quality. Must include date and location.
examples: Tim Hennig, on-site observation, Singita Grumeti, November 2025
Kim, first-hand visit, Four Seasons Nam Hai, March 2026

iucn-redlist.name: IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
iucn-redlist.notes: Authoritative for species conservation status, range maps, population trends

mpru-tanzania.name: Marine Parks and Reserves Unit, Tanzania
mpru-tanzania.notes: Authority for whale shark interaction permits, Mafia Marine Park, Mnemba Atoll

marine-megafauna-foundation.name: Marine Megafauna Foundation
marine-megafauna-foundation.notes: Lead researcher for whale shark ecology in Tanzania/Mozambique. Citizen science via sharkbook.ai

sharkbook.name: Wildbook for Whale Sharks (sharkbook.ai)
sharkbook.notes: Photo-identification database of individual whale sharks globally. ~180–200 Tanzania individuals catalogued

cordio-ea.name: CORDIO East Africa — Coral Reef Degradation in the Indian Ocean
cordio-ea.notes: Peer-reviewed coral health assessments for Pemba, Zanzibar, Mafia reefs

frankfurt-zoological-society.name: Frankfurt Zoological Society (FZS) — Serengeti
frankfurt-zoological-society.notes: Lead scientific partner for Serengeti ecosystem since 1950s. Migration ecology data

grumeti-fund.name: Grumeti Fund
grumeti-fund.notes: Conservation partner for the Singita Grumeti concessions and Serengeti ecosystem protection

unesco-world-heritage.name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
unesco-world-heritage.notes: Official World Heritage inscriptions and site descriptions

tz-immigration-official.name: Tanzania Immigration Department
tz-immigration-official.notes: Official Tanzania visa and entry requirement source

kenya-immigration-official.name: Kenya Directorate of Immigration Services
kenya-immigration-official.notes: Official Kenya entry, eTA, passport, and immigration source

vietnam-immigration-official.name: Vietnam Immigration Department
vietnam-immigration-official.notes: Official Vietnam e-visa and immigration source

visitzanzibar-official.name: Visit Zanzibar — Official Tourism Portal
visitzanzibar-official.notes: Official Zanzibar tourism and travel requirement source

rdb-rwanda.name: Rwanda Development Board
rdb-rwanda.notes: Official Rwanda tourism, permits, and conservation authority

gorilla-doctors.name: Gorilla Doctors
gorilla-doctors.notes: Veterinary and conservation programme for mountain and Grauer's gorillas

uk-fcdo.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office Travel Advice

who-yellow-fever.name: World Health Organization — Yellow Fever
who-yellow-fever.notes: International authority for yellow fever vaccination and disease risk

who-malaria.name: World Health Organization — Malaria
who-malaria.notes: International authority for malaria risk and prevention

cdc-tz.name: CDC Travelers' Health — Tanzania
cdc-tz.notes: US CDC traveler health guidance for Tanzania

amir-2016-plos-one.name: Amir OA et al. (2016) — Tourism impact on Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins, PLOS ONE
amir-2016-plos-one.notes: Definitive study on dolphin tourism impact in Menai Bay, Zanzibar

mbca.name: Menai Bay Conservation Area
mbca.notes: Official management authority for Menai Bay. Boat registration and tourism guidelines

thanda-island.name: Thanda Island — Conservation Programme
thanda-island.notes: Active turtle nest protection programme. Reports from 2017 (first hatchlings) to present

singita.name: Singita — Official communications and conservation reports

tim-firsthand.name: Tim Hennig — First-hand observation
tim-firsthand.notes: Tim Hennig, GM Hotel Matlai Zanzibar. On Zanzibar since 2011. All lodge reviews from paid stays.

kim-firsthand.name: Kim — First-hand observation
kim-firsthand.notes: Kim, Vietnamese, Beyond Paradise Adventures Asia correspondent. First-hand knowledge of Vietnam luxury travel.

uk-fcdo-vietnam-entry.name: UK FCDO (GOV.UK) travel advice: Vietnam, entry requirements
uk-fcdo-vietnam-entry.notes: read 2026-11-16. UK passports only for the exemption. Quotes: "You can visit Vietnam without a visa for up to 45 days for tourism or business."; passport expiry "at least 6 months after the date you arrive"; "from 1 July, if you travel to or transit through Vietnam you may be required to complete a health declaration"; digital arrival card "not currently a mandatory requirement". Page carries no date.

vn-mofa-res44-exemption.name: Vietnam Foreign Ministry embassy page: visa exemption policy (Resolution 44/NQ-CP)
vn-mofa-res44-exemption.notes: read 2026-11-16. Res. 44/NQ-CP (7 March 2025): Germany, France, Italy, Spain, United Kingdom, Russia, Japan, South Korea, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland; "temporary stay duration of 45 days from the date of entry"; "takes effect from March 15, 2025 to March 14, 2028". Page stamp 25/07/2026, other dates on the page conflict.

vn-govnews-res229-exemption.name: Government of Vietnam news portal: visa waiver for 24 countries (Resolution 229)
vn-govnews-res229-exemption.notes: read 2026-11-16. Page of 15 Aug 2025. Res. 229: Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Hungary, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Switzerland; "up to 45 days from the date of entry"; "from August 15, 2025 until August 14, 2028".

vn-govnews-health-declaration.name: Government of Vietnam news portal: health declaration not mandatory for all international travellers from 1 July 2026
vn-govnews-health-declaration.notes: read 2026-11-16. Page of 1 Jul 2026. Ministry of Health: will not be applied "on a mandatory and routine basis to all persons entering, exiting, or transiting through Viet Nam"; Decree No. 165/2026/ND-CP dated 15 May 2026; "the Minister of Health shall issue instructions on subjects and time for health declaration at border gates". Old site tokhaiyte.vn no longer used; new system in development.

vn-govnews-evisa-ports-phuquoc.name: Government of Vietnam news portal: list of ports for e-visa expanded (Resolution 389/NQ-CP), Phu Quoc 30-day exemption
vn-govnews-evisa-ports-phuquoc.notes: read 2026-11-16. Page of 3 Dec 2025. Res. 389/NQ-CP (2 Dec 2025) supplemented 41 border gates, "bringing the total ports to 83" (Long Thanh and Gia Binh airports "once coming into operation"). Phu Quoc: foreign tourists may stay up to 30 days without a visa "provided they remain on the island throughout their stay"; no onward-ticket condition on this page.

vn-evisa-faq.name: Vietnam e-visa portal: FAQ
vn-evisa-faq.notes: read 2026-11-16. Apply at evisa.gov.vn or thithucdientu.gov.vn; e-visa validity must be at least 30 days shorter than passport validity; apply up to 1 year before entry.

vn-evisa-instruction.name: Vietnam e-visa portal: instruction page (border gates list)
vn-evisa-instruction.notes: read 2026-11-16. Lists 27 land, 15 air, 39 sea border gates (81, numbered lists counted by the reader). E-visas can only be used at border gates on the list approved by the Government.

vn-immigration-portal-notice.name: Vietnam Immigration Department: notice on e-visa portal domains
vn-immigration-portal-notice.notes: read 2026-11-16. Notice dated 11/11/2024: from 08:00 on 11/11/2024 the e-visa portal runs on https://thithucdientu.gov.vn and https://evisa.gov.vn. The old address evisa.xuatnhapcanh.gov.vn loads but shows only an access-role message.

vn-mofa-sg-prearrival.name: Vietnam Foreign Ministry embassy page (Singapore): notice on the pre-arrival information declaration
vn-mofa-sg-prearrival.notes: read 2026-11-16. Notice of 02/07/2026. Immigration Department declaration; airports Noi Bai, Tan Son Nhat, Da Nang, Cam Ranh, Phu Quoc; "strongly encourage all foreign travellers to complete the declaration before travelling to Viet Nam"; within three days prior to arrival.

vn-prearrival-portal.name: Vietnam Immigration Department: pre-arrival information portal
vn-prearrival-portal.notes: read 2026-11-16. Asks travellers to complete the declaration "before arrival"; the page does not say it is mandatory.

vietnamnews-prearrival.name: Vietnam News: pre-arrival information system to roll out nationwide after pilot
vietnamnews-prearrival.notes: read 2026-11-16. Article of 11 May 2026 quoting the Immigration Department: nationwide roll-out planned; the pilot at Tan Son Nhat (from 15 April) "remains voluntary". News outlet, so tier 4, labelled vn-gov by the second reader.

vn-travel-visa-requirements.name: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism: visa requirements
vn-travel-visa-requirements.notes: read 2026-11-16. "Last Updated: 2026" (no day). E-visa USD 25 single / USD 50 multiple, up to 90 days, processing 3 to 5 working days; passport valid 6 months beyond entry with two blank pages; Phu Quoc 30 days if flying directly in; exemption groups and bilateral list. Same government as the other Vietnamese sources, so not an independent owner.

vn-travel-res44-exemption.name: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism: Viet Nam waives visas for citizens of 12 countries (Resolution 44/NQ-CP)
vn-travel-res44-exemption.notes: read 2026-11-16. No date shown (likely March 2025). Res. 44/NQ-CP of 7 March 2025, same 12 countries, 45 days from the date of entry, 15 March 2025 to 14 March 2028. Same government as the other Vietnamese sources, so not an independent owner.

avoid_list.reason: User-generated reviews, unverifiable claims, commercial bias in rankings
Commercial platform — price data OK with date citation, wildlife/experience claims unreliable
Commercial aggregator with operator-supplied content — conflict of interest for ethics grading
Marketing content — PADI's research publications acceptable, blog posts are not
